brainCore.title: Brain
brainCore.summary: Local AI second brain: a Markdown vault, a CLI, a web graph, and an MCP server, all on your machine.
brainCore.intro: Brain is a local second brain. The vault, the command line, the web graph, and the MCP server stay on the machine. Paste text, a link, or a screenshot and it becomes a note.
bullets: Markdown vault with wikilinks and tags, plus a CLI, a web graph, and an MCP server.
Capture turns pasted text, URLs, or screenshots into notes.
Runs locally, with Ollama by default, or Groq or Gemini.

Nauc-Me-To.title: NaučMěTo
Nauc-Me-To.summary: Still in development. A quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards from uploaded study material.
Nauc-Me-To.intro: NaučMěTo is still in development. It takes a PDF, slides, or notes and turns them into a quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards. Supabase handles the account, the files, and the database.
bullets: Turns an uploaded PDF, slides, or notes into a quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards.
Supabase handles auth, storage, and the database.

perimeter.title: Perimeter
perimeter.summary: A desk that reads the security headers of this site.
perimeter.intro: Perimeter is a small security desk for this site. It reads the response and says, in plain language, what the browser is being told.
bullets: Reads the response headers of this site.
Shows HTTPS, framing, content type, referrer policy, and permissions.
